probe: asm7090 2>&1 | head -1; s709 2>&1 | head -1; cat /usr/local/share/ibm709x/README-s709-2.4.4.txt | head -2

build.name: assemble
build.cmd: asm7090 -c 7090 -a -f -p -w -x -d LISP15 -t 'BONNIE-S BIRTHDAY ASSEMBLY' -l lisp15.lst.new -o lisp15.out lisp15.src 2>&1 | tail -1; grep -c '^ERROR' lisp15.lst.new; grep '^ERROR' lisp15.lst.new | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5; test "$(grep -c '^ERROR' lisp15.lst.new)" = 0

runs.name: wang-job
runs.cmd: obj2bin lisp15.out lisp15.tape && txt2bcd wang.job wang.bcd && s709 -m7090 -p b7=lisp15.tape a2=wang.bcd p=print.bcd u=punch.bcd < /dev/null; bcd2txt -p print.bcd print.txt 132; cat print.txt | head -80

note: 2026-09-16 P6 expedition. BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY here means: the deck was transcribed against asm7090 2.1.4 (+ the body's own asm7090.patch) / 2.2.2 and the CURRENT asm7090 2.3.2 rejects its $-prefixed cross-namespace references; the run stage is written for the day an assembler accepts the deck and has NOT been exercised.
